NAME              PR to Green
SLUG              pr-to-green
TYPE              loop
PROFILE           @nsollazzo (Nicholas Sollazzo)
TAGLINE           Drive a pull request until CI is green and review approves
DESCRIPTION       A goal loop: fix findings, push, re-check, repeat.
CATEGORY          Productivity
TAGS              ci, automation
OFFICIAL          yes
SOURCE            https://example.com/pr-to-green
CONFIDENCE        official
STATUS            published
DOWNLOADS         12
CREATED           2026-05-01T09:00:00.000Z
UPDATED           2026-05-02T09:00:00.000Z
GOAL              The PR has a fresh approval, green CI, and is mergeable
CHECK COMMAND     gh pr checks --json state
EXIT CONDITION    All checks pass and the latest review is APPROVED
MAX ITERATIONS    20
COMPATIBLE TOOLS  claude-code, codex

KICKOFF
Run the pr-to-green loop on the open PR:
1. Read every review finding.
2. Fix the valid ones, push back on the invalid.
3. Push and re-check until green.
